reason: Bridges QQ group and private chats with DeepSeek Harness agents through the official QQ WebSocket gateway and REST API, with session management, access controls, and configurable host-tool allowlisting.

summaries.zh: 通过 QQ 官方机器人 WebSocket 网关和 REST API，将群聊与私聊消息连接到独立的 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话。
summaries.en: Connects QQ group and private messages to independent DeepSeek Harness agent sessions through the official QQ Bot WebSocket gateway and REST API.

capabilities: Connects to the QQ official Bot API over WebSocket and REST
Routes QQ group and private messages to separate agent sessions
Sends agent responses and explicitly authorized tool messages back to QQ
Supports configurable access allowlists and public access mode
